name: Brad Winderbaum
bio: Brad Winderbaum is an American producer and the Head of Marvel Television, Animation, Comics & Franchise at Marvel Studios. He was formerly a VP of Production & Development at the company. Winderbaum joined Marvel Studios during the production of the company's first feature, Iron Man, as an assistant to Louis D'Esposito . He played a role in developing the studio's immersive marketing, contributing to the creation of behind-the-scenes documentaries and interactive campaigns for films such as Iron Man 2 (2010), Thor (2011), Captain America: The First Avenger (2011), and The Avengers (2012). In his current role, Winderbaum has been a driving force behind Marvel Studios' expansion into television and animation.
